native: User Forever 1.60.1.70862 UI/function acceptance: native menu opens; native type and Flux label change; direct Dispels selection creates missing native pane; final Dispels and new Interrupts four-pane presets both work immediately without an extra setup click. Native combat/secret/taint/gamepad/other-client/FPS remain pending.
scope: Production picker OnClick + backend with widget mocks and pinned native OpenMenu replay only; does not emulate secure VM. Pair wall times are process measurements, not native performance; baseline aborts earlier.
implementation: Native type rows enumerate original native menu descriptions and use public native MenuElementDescriptionProxyMixin.Pick with untouched native data/responders. Explicit type/setup/preset clicks may use original New Window entry, then native type entries. Preset/custom/structure clicks apply all requested native types once; startup/geometry/events never apply types. Native responses update runtime snapshot and guarded matching editor slot. Absorbs removed from catalog; builtin5 uses HPS; legacy unsupported requests normalize working/preview only, serialized custom layouts retained until Save. Added builtin10 Threat/Damage over Interrupts/Healing.
resources: No new frame, event, hook, timer or recurring driver relative to previous candidate. Existing setup Frame becomes Button. Native response and creation use existing two root hooks and geometry coalescer. Native menus allocate their normal resources on user action.
limitations: Blizzard owns menu entries, maximum3 native windows and saved selections; Threat is separate. Absorbs is not advertised because native menus omit it. Native combat/secret/taint/gamepad/FPS checks pending.
